product_summary: Vikunja is an open-source task and project manager.

workflows.title: Add a new task to the Inbox

workflows.goal: Open Inbox and create a task titled 'Prepare agenda for the redesign kickoff meeting'. Verify that it belongs to Inbox.

sample_data.value: Prepare agenda for the redesign kickoff meeting

workflows.success_criteria: Inbox displays a task with the exact supplied title.
